scope: CI5 no automatic replay of uncertain paid work or playlist mutation; current-service audit plus removal of obsolete exposed combined preview. Q13 partial, no whole-goal/90% claim.

finding.evidence: Only renderer caller was unimported/unmounted NewsTest. Main/preload still exposed generation with an in-memory overlap guard but no durable request replay identity. Baseline controlled service invocation loses a text response, then reuses its request ID and dispatches again.

baseline.scope: Actual old NewsService.generate under controlled network responses; proves same-ID service replay can dispatch again. No real provider calls or claim of current mounted UI retries.

finding.qualification: This is a latent exposed alternate paid path. It is not evidence that the current mounted UI automatically retries or that real providers charged twice.

alternatives: Keep the unused API and qualify the invariant claim.
Build another durable combined preview using the existing request protocol.
Remove the unused API, component and single-purpose helpers; retain active durable staged preparation.
decision.selected: Remove the unused alternate path. No current PRD requirement or product caller needs a song-bound one-shot combined preview. Adding a parallel durable workflow would recreate functionality already provided by manual text/audio preparation and saved voice previews.
decision.Boris: Supports removal; explicitly distinguishes latent repeatable API from current UI automatic retry. Final diff review found no actionable regression.
decision.Nadia: Supports removal after independent caller/PRD review; retain shared NewsBreak/progress and active cancellation. Final diff review found no actionable regression.
decision.challenge: Both examined retaining or durably routing a required combined feature. No current consumer/requirement found. Preserve current visible renderer and cancellation/progress contracts; remove only the obsolete path and helpers used solely by it.
